name: lz-switcher-motion
description: SuperSource layouts and key DVE moves with easing curves for ATEM switchers: drag boxes on a picture of the frame, save presets, recall them as smooth moves. macOS, Windows, Linux.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,tsc,electron "vite --config vite.config.mts" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http-get://localhost:4193 dist/electron/main/index.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:4193 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --linux --publish never

author: Lars Zumpe
